correctness.rationale: The only forbidden directed-arc subsets at the threshold are three local forward/reverse collisions per reversed edge and the maximal all-forward cycle. Their disjoint period-three blocks yield the exact join minus one facet. An acyclic toggle matching restricts to one additional critical cell; a simplicial retraction to a cross-polytope sphere annihilates the attaching map. The long exact sequence of the removed facet proves the primitive top-class inclusion. Independent finite face enumeration, gradient DAG checks, Euler and field boundary ranks passed for k=2,3,4 (two primes where feasible).

value.rationale: The first budget at which reverse directed arcs can change the directed-cycle multipath topology is controlled exactly by cyclic length-three domination. In the natural divisible-by-three case, the unique minimum-budget pattern introduces a new lower-dimensional sphere while preserving the original top class primitively; this is an infinite-family integral filtration classification with a sharp and motivated threshold, not a small numerical instance.
